drafted_from: tool row in tools/fine-tune-a-small-model-on-a-persons-rules/tool-rows.json, do-work/score_held_out_lines.py and test/test_fine_tune.py (ScoreAgain.test_reports_again_from_kept_scores), which I ran; a scoring run with a model needs torch and a decider and is not run
start_here: Say to your AI: "Report again on the held-out lines of /work/out/items.json from my earlier scores in /work/kept.json, as run 'again', for set good-set." It writes a request file and runs score_held_out_lines.py on your computer; with a model it scores with and without your adapter.
instructions: 1. Pour the two example rows into your own settings list (see pour), or make list:settings from them, then put your own seed, test share, set names and numbers in the build, train and score objects: every law, line, set name and number is yours, none is built in.
2. Build items.json with tool:build-training-rows-from-a-persons-rules (and train an adapter if you want the after-training numbers).

3. Score once without the adapter and once with it, on the same items file: the AI writes the request (name, items_file, out_dir, pass_set, held_out, base_model, frame, and adapter for the second run) and runs python3 -I tools/fine-tune-a-small-model-on-a-persons-rules/do-work/score_held_out_lines.py <request file>. With scores_from it reports again from kept scores without a model.

4. Read the last line {"result": {results_file, asks, seconds, laws: {<law>: {n_bad, n_good, auc, recall_at_2pct}}}} and tell the person the before and after per rule; a rule with few bad test lines is not measured, say so. Fit the lines a gate uses with tool:fit-pass-and-fail-lines.

worked_examples.title: Report again from kept scores without a model
worked_examples.ask: Report again on the held-out lines from my earlier scores.
worked_examples.given: From tools/fine-tune-a-small-model-on-a-persons-rules/test/test_fine_tune.py (test_reports_again_from_kept_scores), which I ran on the items file of the build example (13 items, 7 of them test lines). kept.json holds adapter "an-adapter" and, for both laws, a score of 0.5 for each of the 7 test lines, 0.7 for the never-trained line "Herewith the parcel." and 0.2 for the held-out card. Request: {"name": "again", "items_file": "/work/out/items.json", "out_dir": "/work", "pass_set": "good-set", "held_out": [{"text": "The held-out card.", "kind": "card", "breaks": [], "unsure": []}], "scores_from": "/work/kept.json"}. Command: python3 -I tools/fine-tune-a-small-model-on-a-persons-rules/do-work/score_held_out_lines.py /work/request.json.
worked_examples.hands_back: Summary lines "again: 18 asks in 0 s", "  plain-words              n_bad   0", "  said-aloud               n_bad   0", then {"result": {"results_file": "/work/again.json", "asks": 18, "seconds": 0.0, "laws": {"plain-words": {"n_bad": 0, "n_good": 7}, "said-aloud": {"n_bad": 0, "n_good": 7}}}}. again.json keeps adapter an-adapter and, per law, the never-trained line's p_fail 0.7 and a top_good list of lines that scored 0.5; with no bad test lines there is no AUC to report, so the laws are not measured. With held_out left empty it refuses and says how to score them again.

lists.label: Settings
lists.holds: One row per tool and scope (a person, a film, a piece or the whole account): the settings that tool reads when it runs, as JSON. For the fine-tune tools the row id is record:setting:fine-tune-a-small-model-on-a-persons-rules~<scope_kind>~<scope_id> and its settings hold a build, a train and a score object that fill every request key the request leaves out.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
